versions.text: Each information, markings and placard displayed in the UCS prescribed in USAR.1541 (a) must be (a) continuously displayed in a conspicuous place relative to the object, indicator or data it is assumed to be associated with; and (b) easily interpreted unambiguously by the UAV crew.

Each information, markings and placard displayed in the UCS prescribed in USAR.1541 (a) must be:
(a) continuously displayed in a conspicuous place relative to the object, indicator or data it is assumed to be associated with; and
(b) easily interpreted unambiguously by the UAS crew.
